title: Family Feud question pack
description: One question pack for the Family Feud party game. Save as data/questions/<name>.json (or the Question Packs folder in a standalone package).

name.description: Display name of the pack, e.g. "Things in Pairs Edition".

question.description: Survey-style prompt, e.g. "Name something that comes in pairs."

answers.description: Board answers, sorted from most to fewest points. 4-8 recommended; points should total 100.

text.description: Answer shown on the board (CAPS by convention; synonyms joined with " / ").

points.description: How many of 100 surveyed people gave this answer.
